This study result revealed that the overall good knowledge about cataract among the study participants was 379 (64.7%) [(95% CI: 60.7-68.6%)]. This finding was consistent with a study conducted in Gondar town, northwest Ethiopia, 61.7% [12]. However, this study linding was lower as compared with other studies; 74.6% in Nepal [16], 87% in rural Peru [17], 74% Iran [18], and 70.9% China [6]. This difference might be due to the variation of the technological advancement of the country, implementation of the health care strategy and the better socio-economic development of the communities.
